description.value: Duffy's Pub is a long-established neighbourhood pub in the Dufferin area of Kamloops that has been serving fresh, made-to-order meals and cold beer since 1984. The kitchen takes pride in hand-battered fish and chips, housemade burger patties, fresh daily soups, and a wide selection of draught and bottled beer. It's a welcoming full-service pub for touring cyclists looking for a hearty sit-down meal and a drink after a long day on the road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is a real, operating neighbourhood pub at 1797 Pacific Way, Kamloops. The phone number 250.372.5453 on the website matches OSM's +1-250-372-5453. No bike-specific amenities (rack, Wi-Fi, takeout, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those fields are null; the website does confirm address and phone but OSM lacked an address field so contact_confirmed.address is null.
